Is the coffee here any good, or should I warn you?
I don't drink coffee in the afternoon, so I am the wrong person to ask. Today I am drinking tea.
Sensible. I am Claire, by the way. What do you do?
Janderson. I work at a bank, in investments. I take care of clients who put money outside Brazil.
So you are the person everybody calls when the market moves. Busy week?
Very. This week I am covering for a colleague as well, so I am dealing with two desks.
Then take the break. I am based on the fourth floor, in legal. We only get busy when somebody else makes a mistake.
That sounds restful. How often do you come to this floor?
At the moment I am covering for a colleague.
What do you do?
Are you based here, or somewhere else?
Sorry, I don't understand. Could you say that again?

Good morning everyone, and welcome to the eighth floor. My name is Claire and I take care of the visitors here. A few practical things before we start. The coffee machine is at the end of this corridor, on the left, and it is free. The meeting rooms are on this floor and they all have the same name, so please look at the number on the door and not at the color. We are testing a new booking system this month, so if a room says available and somebody is inside, that is the system and not the person. Lunch is from twelve to two. And if you need anything at all, I am at the desk by the lift until six.

Hello, you have reached Daniel Prado. I am not at my desk at the moment. I work from home on Mondays and Fridays, so if it is one of those days, the fastest way to find me is by email. This week I am also covering for a colleague, so I am in meetings most of the afternoon. Please leave your name, your number, and one line about what you need, and I promise I call people back the same day. If it is urgent, call the main office and ask for the investments desk. Thank you, and have a good day.

Claire tells him that she works in the same building, on the fourth floor, and asks how often he comes to this office.
